A little about us

We're Peepal.

A strategic talent partner in Bengaluru, twenty years in the making.

For two decades we've helped some of the world's most respected companies find the right people: EY, United Airlines, Goldman Sachs, Citi, Diageo, ANZ, Siemens, Telstra, Salesforce, and many more.

But the work has never really been about logos. It's about people: finding the right ones for our clients, and looking after the ones already here.

True since 2005, and it won't change

Our story

How Peepal came to be

It began with one person, a coffee shop, and a hunch.

Newly arrived in Bengaluru from Uttar Pradesh, Vijay Kumar kept noticing the same thing: companies rise or fall on who they hire. So he staked his career on getting that one thing right. That bet became Peepal.

Twenty years on, the bet still holds. And the story isn't his alone anymore. It's written by everyone who joins it. Soon, that includes you.

We don't just tell this story. We live it, every day. Now we'd like you to help write what comes next.
A look around

Life at Peepal

Your desk would sit in the middle of Bengaluru: open, full of light, a short walk from Trinity Metro and Brigade Road. Inside, it's simple, people who are good at what they do, share what they know, and celebrate the wins, big and small.

People-first culture

Shared prosperity, transparency, meritocracy and strong teamwork, with room to do your best work.

Always learning

Onboarding, training and an L&D culture that encourages growth from day one.

We celebrate

Outings, festivals, Fun Fridays and Team of the Month, the big wins and the small ones.

Rewards & Recognition

As high as you take it.

Variable pay at Peepal is not capped by grade or band. Last year Peepalites took ₹2.43 crore home on top of fixed pay, close to double what the year before paid out. Rewards here are driven by contribution and performance, not tenure or hierarchy.

How you grow

Career growth, on merit

Promotions at Peepal are performance-driven, not tied to a calendar cycle. You become eligible when you meet defined criteria, through a transparent framework based on performance outcomes.

Performance-driven

Growth follows contribution and outcomes, not tenure or hierarchy.

No waiting for a cycle

Eligibility is criteria-based; you move when you're ready, not when the calendar says so.

Transparent & internal

A clear framework, promotion-linked increases, and a strong bias for growing our own.

The full promotion framework, eligibility criteria and performance ratings are preserved exactly as documented and will be linked here. A promotion / hike calculator is planned as a future feature.
